## Checks

- [ ] It builds and the tests pass (`ctest`)
- [ ] New interface texts are in `tr()` and translated, or marked unfinished by `update_translations`
- [ ] The docs say what changed, where behaviour or measurements change
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
